signals.name: web_unhealthy
signals.limitation: liveness does not prove database/API readiness

signals.name: worker_stopped
signals.condition: not running for 60 seconds or 3 restarts in 10 minutes

signals.name: queue_stalled
signals.condition: pending older than 10 minutes or expired running lease older than 5 minutes
signals.limitation: adapter/aggregator requires selected destination and authentication

signals.name: signature_age
signals.condition: age greater than 48 hours warning; 72 hours blocked by application

signals.name: backup_restore_stale
signals.source: signed or access controlled drill receipt
signals.condition: last successful isolated restore older than approved operational schedule
signals.limitation: RPO/RTO/schedule must be supplied by FBR

signals.name: migration_drift
signals.limitation: local manifest verifier alone cannot detect live drift

logging.format: JSON correlation events already implemented in core
